speaker: Doctor
text: How long have you been experiencing swelling in your right knee, and have you noticed any pain or redness? Additionally, does your family history involve anyone with conditions like gout or hemophilia?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Hemophilic Arthropathy (Hemophilia B suspected, given maternal uncle history and painless swelling in a male child).

I need to confirm your blood clotting status. Can you tell me if you or your brother have ever had prolonged bleeding after cuts, dental work, or vaccinations? Also, has a doctor ever told you that you have a clotting disorder?
